description: Vendor watch for x402 buyers: name up to ten seller URLs, or a wallet whose sellers are read from its payments, and for 30 days each is checked daily: price, pay-to, Fair Offer block, Bazaar listing, certification state and latency. A signed diff waits at a free status URL and a pay-to or price change, a lost block, a vanished listing or a failed certification is posted to your webhook. Use when an agent pays the same sellers again and again. No renewal. Price: $1.00 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $1.00 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.

notify.description: Optional https webhook, POSTed on each alert
notify.title: Notify

sellers.description: The x402 offer URLs to watch (up to 10)
